answer_to_use: Report graffiti on BT or Openreach cabinets to Openreach on 0800 023 2023, on Virgin Media cabinets to Virgin Media on 0330 333 0444, and on bus shelters or railway bridges to the company responsible, not the council.

Roads: under 4cm monitored, not automatically repaired. 4 to 7.5cm repair within 6 months (council tries for 2 months). Over 7.5cm repaired within 24 hours. Pavements: under 2cm monitored. 2 to 4cm repair within 6 months. Over 4cm within 24 hours. Staff aim to assess a report within two weeks. Emergencies get a temporary repair within 24 hours.
